text:
Alex: Noticing a weird pattern: webinar signups from the landing page are landing in HubSpot but ~12% are getting an owner of 'unassigned' after enrichment fails. Happens sporadically across US and APAC.
Priya: Is this after the new enrichment vendor rollout? We flipped on vendor-B yesterday at 09:15 PT.
Zoe: Yes, vendor-B returns 503 intermittently. HubSpot workflow currently treats any enrichment error as success with blank properties -> triggers round-robin.
Ravi: That means the RR job picks them up and then SDRs get a blank record. They then backfill manually which spikes ops load. Can we short-circuit those until enrichment finishes?
Alex: Proposal: create a short "enrichment_hold" flag set by workflow when vendor call is pending. Only allow RR when enrichment_status == complete OR enrichment_hold_ts older than 25s. Low-risk and reversible.
Priya: Love the hold flag. Also if vendor-B fails fast with 503, we should escalate to vendor fallback (vendor-A) after 3s.
Zoe: Pseudo-workflow: 
```
# HubSpot workflow
set enrichment_hold_ts = now()
call vendor-B (timeout 3s)
if 200: set enrichment_status=complete, enrichment_hold_ts=null
elif 503 or timeout: call vendor-A sync
if vendor-A 200: set enrichment_status=complete
else: leave enrichment_hold_ts for router debounce
```
Ravi: Router change (fast): add `if enrichment_hold_ts and now() - enrichment_hold_ts < 25s -> skip RR` and log `rr.skip=enrichment_hold`. Feature flag it for NA-West 1% canary.
ops-bot: DEPLOYMENT 1719997782 - router-debounce feature flagged to NA-West 1% started by Zoe.
Alex: Metrics to watch: `marketing.handoff.missed_rate`, `sdr.manual_backfills`, `enrichment.vendorB.error_rate`. Start collecting per-region.
Priya: I'll update the SF field mapping doc to avoid sending partial records to Sales. Also adding a new view `hubspot:enrichment_hold` for SDR queue.
Zoe: I'll roll the router flag, add the log line, and create a Grafana panel for the three metrics. ETA 2h.
Ravi: After 2h stable, increase to 10% and validate SDR ticket count. If good, flip globally.
Alex: Action items: Zoe deploys debounce flag + dashboard (ETA 2h). Priya updates SF mapping + SDR view (ETA 4h). Ravi coordinates canary ramp and monitors backfills (ongoing).
Priya: Quick note for SDRs: filter `enrichment_status != complete and enrichment_hold_ts` and hold outreach until enrichment resolves. Will send a short note in the SDR channel.
Alex: Thanks team. Putting this into the marketing-ops runbook with rollback steps (revert flag, fallback to vendor-A full-time). :rocket:
